parole.significato: smug; supercilious; complacent; nonchalant (arrogantly self-involved, lacking respect for and interest in others)
parole.testo: With adaptation to a German past participle from French blasé, past participle of blaser, from Middle Dutch blâsen, from Proto-Germanic *blēsaną, whence German blasen. Compare semantically aufgeblasen, sich aufblähen.

parole.significato: drug (psychoactive substance, especially one which is illegal)
parole.testo: From French drogue, from Middle French circa 1462, from Middle Dutch droge (Modern Dutch droog).
